title: layout 조기 기록 적격성 분류를 생성 때 저장
missingEvidence: BAR push-template가 먼저 Deferred로 전환하면 이후 이 분류는 호출되지 않음. 실제 도달 범위 우선 확인.
requiredBoundary: 정확한 기존 허용 조건만 보관하고 현재 set/layout 검사는 보존.

risk.function: 낮음~중간: 모든 Vulkan binding flags 거부와 정확한 buffer type 허용을 그대로 저장. 빈/descriptorCount0 layout 의미도 그대로.
risk.lifetime: 소유 layout 내부 bit만 사용; raw layout 주소 cache 금지. 현재 set/layout null 확인 유지.
risk.synchronization: 불변 생성 metadata면 새 lock 불필요.
risk.memory: 기존 Flag 저장공간에 실제로 맞는지 확인해야 함. M3/미도달 layout도 생성 계산을 부담할 수 있음.

strategy: If repeated pre-Deferred queries are established, store the exact current flags/type predicate as immutable layout-owned metadata at construction. No address-keyed global cache and no early-push expansion to manufacture reach.
acceptance: Existing BAR prefix shows repeated layout policy classification before the first Deferred; otherwise close as no useful change
All binding flags, type exclusions, zero descriptors and empty layouts match the original predicate
tests: Existing recording-group policy cases with original predicate as oracle
Foundation ON/OFF and M3 unaffected behavior
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
